extracted.intended_audience: writers submitting work to McSweeney’s publications (humor writers, short fiction authors, book authors, magazine contributors)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for authors preparing and sending work to McSweeney’s various outlets (Internet Tendency, Quarterly Concern, The Believer, or McSweeney’s Books). Advises on appropriate section fit, submission timing, and institutional policies relevant to submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appropriate section / fit
rubrics_metrics.description: We have four different sections where you can submit your work. McSweeney’s Internet Tendency is our humor and satire site. McSweeney’s Quarterly Concern is our print journal, which primarily features short fiction. The Believer is our literature, arts, and culture magazine. McSweeney’s Books is where we publish books (novels, story collections, nonfiction, poetry, and more).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose the correct McSweeney’s outlet for your work — each section has a distinct editorial focus (humor/satire, short fiction, literature/arts/culture, or books). Follow the specific submission guidelines for the section you target (links provided on the page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Section-specific editorial needs and submission frequency
rubrics_metrics.description: Some sections are open for subs more often than others, and editorial needs and submission requirements differ for each.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not assume uniform rules across McSweeney’s; check the linked, section-specific submission guidelines for detailed requirements, formats, and current open/closed submission windows.

rubrics_metrics.name: No AI-assisted writing
rubrics_metrics.description: McSweeney’s accepts no writing aided in any manner by AI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before publishing any writing—from a letter to a book-length work—authors published at McSweeney’s will be asked to attest that AI played no part in the creation or writing of that work. Prepare to confirm authorship/creation provenance as part of the publication process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational sustainability policy (contextual)
rubrics_metrics.description: McSweeney’s is committed to the environment and each year purchases carbon offsets commensurate with their estimate of the impact of printing, shipping, and travel necessary to publish books.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an organizational policy rather than a submission criterion, but the company reviews business decisions through a lens of sustainability. Contact the executive director to support or to learn more.
